summary: Independent review of the alert-triage implementation. ALERT ROUTING AND SEVERITY ONLY; no trading logic. THE OPERATOR'S REASON FOR THIS WORK, which is the standard it must be judged against: today's alerts made him ask whether the project was unhealthy while the system was in fact working correctly. We were training him to ignore his own safety net. Measured 2026-09-11: 34 alerts, of which 21 were one identical fleet-health line and 9 were bar-gap detection/recovery/halt messages for self-healing holes; about 4 were actionable. MY OWN RULE 3A WAS WRONG AND CODEX-2 STOPPED BEFORE BUILDING IT — correctly. I proposed discriminating a manual position by whether we had ever placed an order for the symbol, and I supported it with 'XHLD has 210 orders'. That number was count(*) on broker_orders with NO account filter and NO date filter — all time, all three accounts, paper included. As codex showed, 'any order ever' marks BOTH symbols ours and 'any order today' marks BOTH manual, so it cannot produce the distinction I claimed. The implemented discriminator is codex's, not mine: NET FILL BALANCE per account and symbol, which is tied to the current episode and immune to retention. I VERIFIED THE UNDERLYING FACTS INDEPENDENTLY BEFORE ACCEPTING THE POLICY: on live:schwab_1m_v2 all-time, XHLD is 24 bought / 24 sold across 12 fills each with its last activity 2026-08-12 15:47 ET, and TNON is 18 bought / 18 sold across 9 fills each with its last activity 2026-09-10 07:55 ET — both net ZERO. And the bot has exactly ONE trade size on Schwab: 393 fills in 30 days, every one quantity 2. A 500-share XHLD position and a 1,000-share TNON position cannot be ours by construction, so both of today's criticals were manual. THE DECISION TREE IS BETTER THAN WHAT I SPECIFIED and I want that recorded: the INFO/manual verdict requires BOTH our live books AND our fill balance to disagree with the broker, so any single source claiming a position escalates instead; it adds a case I did not specify — a NEGATIVE net fill balance, our ledger reading net short, as its own critical; and it keeps the operator's direction-B rule intact, records claiming a position the broker does not have is always critical with no discriminator. Quantity is context only and has a control named for it. MUTATIONS, ALL RED: manual case paged as critical -> 3 controls fail, so the noise cannot return; the manual branch widened to swallow an owned position -> 6 fail, which is the dangerous case of hiding a real orphan as 'not ours'; broker_missing_owned_position downgraded to info -> 2 fail, so the direction the operator called out stays loud; bar-gap PAGE_AFTER_SECS set to 0 -> its shell suite fails; set to 999999 -> its shell suite fails. METHOD CORRECTION, RECORDED: my first two bar-gap mutations ran the PYTHON suite against a SHELL script change and survived meaninglessly; re-run against the script's own 23-test shell harness, both turn red. That is the fourth mis-targeted mutation I have made today and the reason I now identify the covering harness before mutating. Controlled full unit pair vs base ad2ce28f: base 46 failed / 3686 passed, head 46 failed / 3706 passed, ZERO new failure names and ZERO fixed. Ruff clean on CI scope and on every file this PR touches. Bar-gap shell suite 23 passed. Ancestor PASS. Reviewer differs from the author. No findings; nothing withheld.
